                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                        (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            if color != 1:
                comps.append((color, cells))

    # Locate an L-shaped guide made of two long perpendicular strokes.
    guides = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        rs = [r for r, c in cells]
        cs = [c for r, c in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        if r1 - r0 < 3 or c1 - c0 < 3:
            continue
        if (sum(r == r0 for r, c in cells) >= 4 and
            sum(c == c1 for r, c in cells) >= 4) or (
            sum(r == r1 for r, c in cells) >= 4 and
            sum(c == c0 for r, c in cells) >= 4) or (
            sum(r == r0 for r, c in cells) >= 4 and
            sum(c == c0 for r, c in cells) >= 4) or (
            sum(r == r1 for r, c in cells) >= 4 and
            sum(c == c1 for r, c in cells) >= 4):
            guides.append((color, cells))

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not guides:
        return out
    guide_color, guide = max(guides, key=lambda item: len(item[1]))

            continue

        targets.append((d, cells))

    if targets:
        _, cells = min(targets, key=lambda item: item[0])
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = guide_color
    return out
